phase: base, then baseurl-unset applied twice by the section (overlay-baseurl-unset.json)

steps.action: The operator removes BASE_URL from the deployment and restarts; Application address becomes editable and the API falls back to its default
steps.expected: Field editable with source Default; sign-in works only at the default address
steps.actual: phase baseurl-unset applied to openlaw-docs-9d2b1705-aoauth (2026-09-28T07:32:22Z). A password sign-in at http://127.0.0.1:43351 got me 401 with "Invalid origin". At http://localhost:3000 Daniel signed in, and Instance address showed "Application address Default" (field value "http://localhost:3000", read-only false).

steps.action: An Administrator saves Application address; it waits for a restart of the API and worker
steps.expected: Save shows the restart notice and the pending notice; the callback still uses the old address
steps.actual: Entering http://127.0.0.1:43351 and Save showed "Settings saved. Restart the API and worker to apply changes." The pane then showed "Application address Saved in OpenLaw; Active: http://localhost:3000; Saved changes are waiting for a restart. The active values below are still in use by this API." (field value "http://127.0.0.1:43351"). Before the restart, Save provider showed the callback http://localhost:3000/api/auth/sso/callback.

steps.action: After the API and worker restart, the saved Application address is active: new sign-ins and the SSO callback use it
steps.expected: Saved in OpenLaw; sign-in at the saved address works; callback on it
steps.actual: phase baseurl-unset applied to openlaw-docs-9d2b1705-aoauth (2026-09-28T07:32:49Z). A password sign-in at http://127.0.0.1:43351 worked again. Instance address showed "Application address Saved in OpenLaw" (field value "http://127.0.0.1:43351"). Save provider showed the callback http://127.0.0.1:43351/api/auth/sso/callback.
